Yes. I found several Toronto/GTA options that explicitly advertise month-to-month or no long-term contracts, which fits a test-first approach:

Metabaz Digital Marketing Agency — Richmond Hill/GTA. Meta/Facebook & Instagram management starts at $599 CAD/month, ad spend separate, with no minimum term or lock-in. They also handle creative, tracking and A/B testing. 
MetaBaz

Nano Digital — Toronto. Offers Meta advertising management with month-to-month/no long-term contracts and says there are no minimum ad-spend requirements.

ORCAFY Marketing Agency — Etobicoke. Focuses heavily on Meta advertising, creative testing and lead generation, and says it doesn't tie clients into year-long contracts. 
Orcafy

AdTribe — Downtown Toronto. Particularly worth considering if you're an e-commerce/DTC business; it offers Facebook/Instagram paid acquisition and advertises no long-term contracts.

Flux Marketing — Toronto. Smaller, performance-focused practice that positions itself around no long-term contracts/no hidden fees and paid social including Meta.

My shortlist for a test: I'd start by comparing Metabaz, Nano Digital, and ORCAFY. For a small business, I'd specifically ask each one for a 30–60 day test plan, minimum ad spend, what creative they'll produce, and exactly what happens if you cancel.

One important distinction: “no contract” doesn't necessarily mean inexpensive. For example, Metabaz's $599/month is the management fee; your Facebook/Instagram ad spend is additional. 
MetaBaz

If you tell me what your Toronto business sells and roughly how much you want to spend on ads per month (e.g. $500, $1,000, $2,000), I can narrow this to the 3 best-fit agencies and compare their pricing, contract terms, and services.
